intro.text: Shadows Remembered is a Rosharan book of children's tales about the Voidbringers, collected over many years by an unnamed woman curious about darkeyed folklore.

description.text: It is a thin red book bound in hogshide. The Palanaeum keeps a copy in the same room as Dialogues.

items.text: Having seen Jasnah reading it, Shallan went to the Palanaeum to find it, expecting philosophy about some killing from the past. She was let down by its plain folktales.
Jasnah's notes showed that she did not dismiss Voidbringer legends, since folktales might hold some truth.
